name: scene3d_search_library_objects
description: Search the curated 3D asset catalog for up to 8 named models in one call via `searches` (English terms, e.g. "tree" not "árbol"). Results are separated by query and include every match, grouped by category, with glb_url + default transforms. Also returns `mocapClips`: the exact mocap ids, complete names, labels, categories, and two-person pairIds; pass each `name` as-is to scene3d_patch_object_clip. `search` is a legacy single-query alias. size = w×h×d world units at curated scale. size_m = same in real-world meters. @see guides_get('scene3d')

search.description: Legacy alias for one search query. Prefer `searches`.
